cards.text: Some time after Israel's big win over Aram (1 Kings 20:29), we're in Jezreel. A man named Naboth the Jezreelite owns a vineyard there. And that vineyard sits right next to the palace of Ahab, king of Samaria.

cards.question: King Ahab has his eye on the vineyard next door. What does he want to turn it into?
For Naboth's vineyard, Ahab offers him a better vineyard in its place, or its value in ___.

cards.text: A KING just walked over with a deal, friend, and most of us would say yes before he finished talking. Not Naboth.

cards.question: Naboth tells King Ahab no. What reason does Naboth give?

answers.text: It's the inheritance of his fathers
The king's offer is far too low
He already promised it to his son

cards.text: So Ahab goes home to his palace, sullen and angry.

cards.question: Back at the palace, Ahab lies down on his bed, turns his face away and refuses to ___.

cards.text: Then his wife Jezebel comes in and asks, 'Why are you so sullen that you refuse to eat?' Friend, a grown man with a CROWN, face turned away, over a vegetable garden.

cards.question: Ahab tells Jezebel what Naboth said. True or false: Ahab mentions that the vineyard is the inheritance of Naboth's fathers.

cards.text: Jezebel isn't having it. She says, 'Do you not reign over Israel?' and tells him to get up, eat something and cheer up.

cards.question: Then Jezebel makes Ahab a promise. What is it?

answers.text: She will get him Naboth's vineyard
She will find him a better vineyard

cards.text: Then Jezebel writes letters in Ahab's name and seals them with his seal. That's a message hitting the whole group chat from YOUR number, with YOUR name on it.

cards.question: Jezebel's sealed letters go out. True or false: she sends them to the elders and nobles of Naboth's city.

cards.text: Her letters say, 'Proclaim a fast and give Naboth a seat of honor among the people.' Friend, I don't trust that seat of HONOR one bit.

cards.question: Jezebel's letters say to seat two ___ across from Naboth.
Jezebel wants two men to testify against Naboth. What are they supposed to accuse him of?

answers.text: Cursing both God and the king

cards.question: Jezebel's letters arrive in Naboth's city. True or false: the elders and nobles do what the letters tell them.

cards.text: They proclaim the fast and give Naboth his seat of honor. Then the two scoundrels sit down across from him and testify in front of everyone: 'Naboth has cursed both God and the king!'
So they take Naboth outside the city and stone him to death. Friend, this one is heavy.
The elders and nobles of Naboth's city send word back to Jezebel: 'Naboth has been stoned to death.' Then Jezebel goes to her husband.

cards.question: Jezebel tells Ahab that Naboth is dead. What does she tell Ahab to do?

answers.text: Go take possession of the vineyard

cards.question: The king who wouldn't get off his bed hears that Naboth is dead. True or false: Ahab gets up and goes down to take the vineyard.

cards.text: But the LORD sees all of it. Then the word of the LORD comes to Elijah the Tishbite, God's prophet.

cards.question: The word of the LORD comes to Elijah the Tishbite. What does the LORD tell him to do?

answers.text: Go down and meet King Ahab
Hide from Jezebel in the hills

cards.text: The LORD gives Elijah a question to bring to Ahab: 'Have you not murdered a man and seized his land?'

cards.question: Then the LORD gives Elijah a second message for Ahab, and it's about Naboth's blood. What does it say?

answers.text: Dogs will lick up Ahab's blood where they licked Naboth's
Naboth's sons will take back their land from Ahab
Fire will burn Ahab's palace in Jezreel

cards.text: Elijah shows up, and Ahab says, 'So you have found me out, my enemy.' Friend, that's getting caught with your hand in the cookie jar and calling the guy who caught you the villain.

cards.question: Ahab calls Elijah his enemy. True or false: Elijah says he found Ahab out because Ahab sold himself to do evil.

cards.text: Then Elijah gives Ahab the LORD's words. The LORD says He will bring calamity on him and cut off every male from Ahab in Israel.

cards.question: The LORD says He'll make Ahab's house like the houses of Jeroboam and Baasha, two earlier kings of Israel. Why?

answers.text: Ahab provoked His anger and caused Israel to sin
Ahab trusted his army instead of the LORD
Ahab refused to listen to the prophet Elijah

cards.question: The LORD has a word about Jezebel too: the dogs will devour her by the wall of ___.

cards.text: Elijah goes on: anyone belonging to Ahab who dies in the city will be eaten by dogs, and anyone who dies in the field will be eaten by the birds of the air.

Then the writer steps in with a note: there was never one like Ahab, who sold himself to do evil, incited by his wife Jezebel. He went after idols, just like the Amorites the LORD had driven out before Israel.

cards.question: Ahab hears every word Elijah brought. Then he tears his clothes and puts on ___.

cards.text: He fasts, lies down in sackcloth and walks around meekly. Friend, this is the SAME man who just called Elijah his enemy!

cards.question: Then the word of the LORD comes to Elijah again. True or false: the LORD tells Elijah that Ahab has not truly humbled himself.
Because Ahab humbled himself, what does the LORD say about the calamity?

answers.text: It will come on his house in his son's days
It will never come on his house at all
It will fall only on Jezebel instead

cards.text: Slide that one onto the cooling rack, friend. Ahab's story still has more pages to go.
